criteria.support_condition: A reliable dated record establishes that, after the post, OpenAI failed to make a payment owed and due to a counterparty.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive terminal record establishes that OpenAI settled every obligation and ceased operations without the predicted payment failure. Continued payments during a finite period do not contradict an unlimited forecast.
